WITH winners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ma.player_id, p.bats
  FROM manager_award ma
  JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id
),
counts AS (
  SELECT 
    bats,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM winners
  GROUP BY bats
),
total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_cnt
  FROM winners
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(counts.bats, '') as hand,
  counts.cnt as winner_count,
  counts.cnt * 1.0 / total.total_cnt as share
FROM counts
CROSS JOIN total
ORDER BY COALESCE(counts.bats, '')
